VBO:0201041.summary: Lively and curious, Pomchis tend to stay close to their people, mixing busy play with lap time. They may be more reserved with strangers and announce newcomers with plenty of barking. This Pomeranian–Chihuahua cross varies in coat and build rather than following one fixed appearance.
VBO:0201041.shortDescription: A lively Pomeranian–Chihuahua cross, fond of close company and apt to announce newcomers with barking.
